verdict.rationale: CrewAI's core product is multi-agent orchestration: Crews (collaborative groups of agents), sequential/hierarchical processes, task delegation between agents, and Flows for event-driven coordination across tasks/crews — all well documented with concrete code examples, plus community hands-on confirmation of a working multi-agent crew. Missing for 10: independent third-party benchmarking of complex handoff scenarios beyond a single HN anecdote.
